requirement.description: Data validation is currently missing. That is simply how the data validation process is set up today.
requirement.reading: That is simply how the data validation process is set up today.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: The current data pipeline between {data_dave} and the feature store lacks automated validation. Data is passed directly from the ingestion script to the feature store without any checks for consistency or quality. The team relies on manual spot-checking during the daily stand-up to catch obvious issues. There is no formal process for logging or tracking validation results. The system does not currently enforce any rules about data format or range values.
output.reclassify_reason: The statement describes an existing situation without any expression of wishes, refusals, acceptances, or needs.
